'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Western Russia attacks]]
****Three [[Russian military]] members are killed by debris after [[Russia]] shoots down a drone that was approaching the [[Engels-2 (air base)|Engels air base]] in [[Saratov Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/russia-says-3-killed-as-troops-down-ukrainian-drone-headed-for-air-base/ (AFP via ''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Six [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] members are killed and an unknown number of others are injured during an [[ambush]] by five [[Islamic State]] gunmen in [[Raqqa]]. One of the attackers is killed and another is arrested. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/26/suicide-attack-in-raqqa-kills-several-kurdish-security-officers (Al Jazeera)]
**Six [[Turkey|Turkish]]-backed [[National Front for Liberation]] [[militant]]s are killed during a fight with the Syrian Democratic Forces and the [[Syrian Army]] in [[Aleppo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/islamic-state-group-syria-f9a6e551cfda50880f5c6f30239ab787 (AP)]
*[[Korean conflict]]
**Five [[North Korea]]n [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] cross the [[Korean Demilitarized Zone|DMZ]] into [[South Korea]], which prompted the South Korean military to launch aircraft to intercept the drones. One of the South Korean [[KAI KT-1 Woongbi#Variants|FA-1 light attack aircraft]] crashed shortly after takeoff and a North Korean drone crashed after breaching [[Seoul|Seoul's]] [[airspace]]. It is believed that North Korea launched the drones in response to criticism of the quality of North Korean [[satellite image]]s. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/seoul-says-military-fired-at-n-korean-drones-after-incursion/ar-AA15FDeT?ocid=entnewsntp&cvid=295828ab8c5343f69179282cb08c7d5e (AFP via MSN)] [https://www.dailynk.com/김여정-막말-엿새-만에-북한-무인기-수대-영공-침범/ (Daily NK)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**At least ten people are killed and five others are injured when a bus hits a [[landmine]] in [[Fada N'gourma]], [[Est Region (Burkina Faso)|Est]], [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-64097377 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Paris shooting#Aftermath|Aftermath of the 2022 Paris shooting]]
**A [[Judiciary of France|French judge]] [[Indictment|indicts]] a 69-year-old man with murder, [[attempted murder]] [[Hate crime|due to race]], and the [[Criminal possession of a weapon|unlawful procurement and possession of a weapon]] for killing three people and injuring three others in the [[10th arrondissement of Paris]] on December 23. The suspect had confessed to having been motivated by [[racism in France|racism]]. [https://www.deccanherald.com/international/world-news-politics/suspect-charged-with-deadly-shooting-of-kurds-in-paris-1175391.html (AFP via ''Deccan Herald'')]
